input.quote: This Agreement shall become effective on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of three (3) years unless terminated as provided in Section 5.0. This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs for a fixed three-year initial term and Section 5.0 permits termination only for cause (material breach, insolvency events, force majeure) under Section 5.1; the only other exit is a six-month non-renewal notice, which operates at the end of a renewal period rather than as a mid-term convenience right. IBM therefore has no right to terminate for convenience during a multi-year term, which is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback (60-90 days' notice with a capped early-termination fee). IBM's ability to cancel Purchase Orders for convenience under Statement of Work Section 6.1 (subject to cost reimbursement) mitigates but does not substitute for an Agreement-level exit. MSL holds no convenience right either, so the redline is limited to adding an IBM convenience right on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid amounts, preserving the existing Sections 5.2/5.3 wind-down and pricing bargain.

proposal.summary: Add IBM termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid amounts; confirm MSL has no convenience right during the term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The three-year term in Section 4.0 can only be exited for cause or by six months' non-renewal notice, so we have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid amounts, consistent with our playbook position that we can exit on notice without penalty. Wind-down and pricing on exit remain governed by Sections 5.2 and 5.3; if 30 days is too short we can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: 5.4 Termination for Convenience. In addition to the rights set forth in Section 5.1, IBM may terminate this Agreement, any Product Attachment, or any Purchase Order for its convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) Days prior written notice to MSL, without payment of any termination penalty or early termination charge. MSL shall have no right to terminate this Agreement, any Product Attachment, or any Purchase Order for convenience during the term. Upon termination by IBM under this Section 5.4, MSL shall refund to IBM any amounts prepaid by IBM for the period after the effective date of termination, and the rights and obligations of the Parties shall otherwise be as set forth in Sections 5.2 and 5.3, which shall apply to such termination as if it were an expiration of this Agreement.
